identity.name: Annual Calendar Regulator
identity.one_liner: The Patek regulator — the only regulator-style watch in Patek's modern catalogue, with a single hour hand, a separate minute hand, and a sub-seconds subdial. The quietest Patek complications piece.

provenance_events.description: Patek Philippe releases the 5235 as the brand's only regulator-style watch — a single hour hand at 6, a central minute hand, an annual calendar with day/date/month in a sub-dial at 6.

narrative.story: The 5235 is Patek's only modern regulator — a layout where the hour is on a sub-dial and only the minute is on a central hand. Patek has long resisted the regulator style (which is associated with German watchmaking) but in 2011 they made one for the Asian market's preference for asymmetric dial layouts.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial is a matte black or silver with applied baton indices. The regulator sub-dial is at 6 with three sub-dials (day, date, month) and a sub-seconds.
